profile.headline: Lead Principal Engineer at FIS
profile.summary:
I love building solutions, gaming - when the kids allow, and working on creative projects (drawing, woodworking, landscaping, ...). I enjoy learning and using new technologies, as well as applying them at work and on personal projects.



Two of my main strengths are my ability to quickly learn, adapt, and dive deep into the weeds of how things work; and my love for difficult, or even "impossible" challenges. I thrive in helping figure out solutions to complex problems and in getting people "unstuck".

positions.title: Web Front-End Software Engineer
positions.description:
I act as the team's UX/UI developer. I enjoy improving how systems look, and how they perform, while also creating parts that can be shared with other teams. Some of my tasks here:
- Improve usability and ease of access by redesigning (UX and UI) components and sections of frontend system.
- Reduce production time for multiple teams by producing reusable, plugable components using Angular 4/5.
- Optimize performance, usability, look-and-feel, and structure of system by reviewing, refactoring, or rewriting existing technologies and codebase.
- Plan, organize, and lead trainings in Angular 4/5.

positions.title: Lead Web/Game Developer
positions.description:
- Reduced time used to add new levels to game by building a mini-scale game engine written in JavaScript (AngularJS), and by automating repetitive processes, using Grunt.
- Ensured performance and timely delivery of product by leading, supervising, reviewing, training, and managing a team of 8 developers in charge of creating The Tessera.
- Increased number of final assets for the game by editing, creating, and/or optimizing images, audios, and videos using Gimp, Photoshop, Audition, and other tools.

positions.title: Web Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a migration system that enabled schools to transfer entire courses from Moodle to our custom course management system (CMS).
Provided communication between the company and their clients by periodically meeting with teachers and principals to gather requirements and evaluate potential roadblocks.
Added features to our CMS using Silex (PHP) for the backend, AngularJS (JavaScript) for the frontend, and Phinx (PHP) for migrations on a MySQL database.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Programmed and fixed components of several web applications, as well as web-based mini-games used for LDS missionaries learning a foreign language.
All projects were written using AngularJS in the frontend, and Java for the backend, using an Oracle database.

positions.title: Development Specialist
positions.description:
Improved performance, stability, speed, and scalability of prototype online learning suite by rewriting it using PHP, JavaScript, and MySQL.
Optimized the online suite further by rewriting it on a more modern framework, using AngularJS, Java, and Oracle.

positions.title: English Teacher
positions.description:
Prepared teaching material and taught English daily to 2 Intermediate-Level classes.
Created and revised exams for students.

positions.title: Spanish Teacher
positions.description:
Prepared teaching material and trained LDS missionaries going to Spanish-speaking countries.
Trained 50-60 teachers weekly (covered for Area Coordinator for more than 2 months).
Trained and evaluated new teachers in the area.
Maintained communication with and supervised 10 Zone Coordinators and 50+ Teachers.
Created, designed, compiled, and tested new material weekly to train teachers.
